newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia applies cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Iberia applies cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Spain's state airline Iberia has introduced a cargo fuel surcharge of 13 pesetas per kg, equivalent to US$10 cents, to cover increased fuel costs, air cargo industry sources told Reuters.
The rises apply so far to international routes only and were effective from November 11, an official at a foreign airline operating said.
Iberia cargo spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.

The move follows cargo fuel surcharges of US$10 cents, or the equivalent in local currencies, announced since October 25 by many airlines led by the main European carriers. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
